messages:
Jordan Kim: quick follow-up from today's all-hands
Can we get a compact table of owners + realistic canary windows for API / Console / Optimize? engineering teams need to lock sprint scope.

Aisha Khan: short answers: API GA (hosted gen/chat parity) -> target 2026-07-25. Console opt-in beta -> 2026-07-05. Optimize preview (cost recommendations + batching) -> 2026-09-01. owners below.

Liam O'Connor: are these timelines assuming no perf regressions in current perf sprint? any kms/hsm dependencies?

Aisha Khan: perf regressions would push API by 2
weeks; KMS/HSM work is separate and only affects Private deploys. Hosted GA doesn't require new KMS flows.

Nina Park: owners (proposed):
- API GA: Aisha (PM) + Liam (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Jordan (Product) + Nina (DevEx lead)
- Optimize preview: Liam (ML infra) + Nina (Product eng)
I'll create a shared checklist doc and set a 20m weekly sync.

Jordan Kim: please add canary start/end, rollback signal, and docs owner. also include SDK bump notes.

DevEx-bot: Recorded all-hands: https://meet.corp/rec/1756789000 (slides in drive)

Liam O'Connor: quick canary suggestion for API: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 20% over 2 weeks. Rollback if 500s spike OR median p95 latency +30% from baseline.

Aisha Khan: Console beta will be opt-in for orgs; no admin API breaking changes. we'll use feature-flagging for rollout.

Nina Park: Optimize preview depends on runtime telemetry being stable for model-level token costs. ETA for telemetry lock: 2026-06-28. if it slips, preview moves +3 weeks.

Jordan Kim: can someone post a minimal canary config we can copy into launch runbooks?

Liam O'Connor: pasted a snippet: 
```
canary: {
  initial_traffic: 1,
  steps: [1,5,20],
  duration_days: 14,
  rollback_triggers: ["5xx_rate>0.5%","p95_latency>baseline*1.3"]
}
```

Aisha Khan: action items I'm tracking:
- Nina: checklist doc + owners by 2026-06-10
- Liam: final canary plan + health checks by 2026-06-18
- Aisha: partner migration notes + SDK compatibility by 2026-06-22
I'll slot a weekly 20m review on calendars.

Nina Park: I'll draft the one-pager and include a migration compatibility table for partners. expect v1 by EOD 2026-06-10.

Jordan Kim: thanks. last ask 
PM/eng leads 
please flag any >10 day slips in this thread so we can re-align priorities.

DevEx-bot: Note: follow-up doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/followups/1756789012 (edit access: owners)
